summary:
科林研發最新季度財報表現強勁，受惠於半導體設備需求成長，營收與每股盈餘皆優於市場預期。
• 每股盈餘 (EPS) 達 1.82 美元，優於市場預期的 1.68 美元。
• 季度營收達 67.2 億美元，較去年同期顯著成長 29.99%。
• 受惠於先進邏輯與記憶體製程設備需求，獲利能力持續擴張。
ai_view:
觀點：訊號偏向正面，顯示半導體設備復甦力道穩健。對股價短中期而言，強勁基本面提供支撐，但高本益比可能限制估值擴張空間。後續需追蹤主要晶圓廠的資本支出計畫與出貨動能。

需留意：本益比處於 52.10 的相對高位，估值壓力偏高。；全球半導體資本支出週期循環與地緣政治供應鏈變數。

summary_en:
Lam Research reported strong quarterly earnings, driven by robust semiconductor equipment demand, beating top and bottom-line estimates.
• EPS of $1.82 outperformed the estimated $1.68.
• Quarterly revenue reached $6.72 billion, marking a 29.99% year-over-year growth.
• Profitability expanded, driven by strong demand for advanced logic and memory manufacturing equipment.

view: Positive signal indicating solid recovery momentum in semiconductor equipment. For the near to mid-term, strong fundamentals support the stock, though a high P/E ratio may limit valuation expansion. Track major foundries' capital expenditure plans and shipment momentum going forward.

Watch：Trailing P/E ratio stands at 52.10, indicating elevated valuation pressure.; Cyclicality in global semiconductor capital expenditures and geopolitical supply chain uncertainties.
